notes: Site feature-coverage expansion: the marketing site told the positioning story but almost none of the product. An audit against the 31 capability documents found 25 of them with zero mention on the site, no Web3 story at all, a console mock from before the activation car, and evidence facts too thin to verify. All fixed in one pass while keeping every number exactly as the README states it. A new capabilities section carries twelve honest one-line-plus-one-fact cards - console chat with streaming, voice session and media BYOK, the skill workshop, dual-layer memory, natural-language cron and the evolution loop, the 9-route gateway, the desktop HUD, multi-profile isolation, terminal backends with execute_code, subagents and MCP, hooks and context files, and the OpenAI-shaped gateway - followed by the Web3 block: nine venues, three CEX credential slots, six exchange tools, the prepare -> human approval -> execute gate with caps that ship at zero (fail-closed), and the honest note that withdrawals and on-chain transfers do not exist by construction. The onboarding story now explains step three with the activation checklist and the console mock shows the six-card Overview including the credential slot editor, doctor, restart and update controls. Facts grew the verifiable evidence rows: twelve real-machine E2E legs, the 99/99 setup wizard, 63/63 profile isolation, 15/15 desktop shell, 25 tools, 31 capability documents and the ~13.4k LOC core. OG tags, a canonical URL, footer links and a rewritten llms.txt product section keep the machine-readable surface in step; sitemap lastmod is current; the site pack grew 165 -> 216 keys with strict en/zh parity. Assertions grew with the content: the site gate went 43 -> 62 legs (new number pins, Chinese-card CJK checks, a pack-parity leg) and the layout e2e 48 -> 59 (anchor navigation, six mock cards, mobile no-overflow), deploy checks now verify zh.json and the llms facts - all green, deployed and verified live.
